title: feat(l1sparse): sparsest 1-site filler is not f_L1
science: A sharp uniqueness theorem plus a forcing negative against L1, not a probe cell. Over the 96 cube-covariant 1-site fillers of the two-cube, the support minimum is m=26 attained by exactly N_min=1 map - and the unique minimizer is NOT f_L1 (supp 56 = 64 minus the 8 fully balanced cells) but f_min, the nonempty axis-transversal predicate (at most one occupied sign per axis), with the clean identity
